title: Heterolanthanide three-nuclear iodide-sulfide-nitride clusters. Unusual synthesis way and structure

material_class.structural_family: heterotrinuclear iodide-sulfide-nitride cluster with bridging S2 and S2N2

synthesis.procedure: Under vacuum/Schlenk or argon glove-box conditions, a suspension of [(NdI)3N2(THF)6] (266 mg, 0.178 mmol), TbI3(THF)3 (96 mg, 0.127 mmol) and sulfur (25 mg, 0.78 mmol) in 17 mL THF was stirred in an ultrasonic bath for 10 h at 60 °C. The mixture was centrifuged and the yellow solution was separated from the precipitate by decantation. Slow evaporation of THF gave a mixture of yellow-orange and light yellow crystals, which were washed with cold THF and dried under reduced pressure (264 mg mixed crystals). Yellow-orange crystals of 3 were separated mechanically from light yellow crystals of homometallic cluster 1.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ultrasonic bath; Schlenk/vacuum or argon glove-box
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: centrifugation and decantation; slow evaporation of THF; wash with cold THF; dry under reduced pressure; mechanical separation of yellow-orange crystals of 3 from light yellow 1

properties.summary: Room-temperature magnetic moment 5.6 µB, corresponding to two Nd3+ and one Tb3+ (literature 3.3 and 9.5 µB) and indicating no intramolecular magnetic coupling at room temperature; EPM Nd/Tb ≈ 2.3/1 due to admixture of cluster 1.

measurements.name: magnetic moment
measurements.conditions: room temperature; flotation method in ethanol; sample contains some homometallic cluster 1

material_class.structural_family: heterotrinuclear iodide-sulfide-nitride cluster with bridging S2 and S2N2

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 3 from [(NdI)3N2(THF)6] (216 mg, 0.130 mmol), TmI3(THF)3 (126 mg, 0.164 mmol) and sulfur (25 mg, 0.78 mmol) in 17 mL THF (ultrasonic bath, 60 °C as in Scheme 1). Isolated as yellow-orange crystals; one crystal used for X-ray study. Product contains ~25% admixture of homometallic cluster 1 (EPM Nd/Tm = 2.6).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: same as 3 (ultrasonic bath; Schlenk/vacuum or argon glove-box)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: isolated as yellow-orange crystals used for X-ray diffraction

properties.summary: Room-temperature magnetic moment 4.7 µB, consistent with the observed Nd/Tm ratio and Tm3+ moment 7.3 µB; no intramolecular magnetic coupling at room temperature.

measurements.name: magnetic moment
measurements.conditions: room temperature; crystals with ~25% admixture of cluster 1

material_class.structural_family: proposed heterotrinuclear iodide-sulfide-nitride cluster analogous to 3/4

synthesis.procedure: Main text states that [(NdI)3N2(THF)6] reacts with sulfur and LaI3(THF)3 under comparable conditions to 3/4; isolated product does not form X-ray-quality crystals. Quantitative procedure is referred to the Supplementary Information, which was not supplied in this run.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: product isolated but crystals unsuitable for X-ray

properties.summary: Magnetic measurements (Table S3) together with elemental analysis and EPM are cited as supporting a composition close to Nd2LnI5(S2)(S2N2)(THF)n (n = 9); room-temperature moments of the heterolanthanide series are described as close to the sum of two Nd3+ and one Ln3+ with no intramolecular coupling. Numerical La-specific values are not given in the main text.

material_class.structural_family: iodide-sulfide acetonitrile adduct from cluster decomposition

synthesis.procedure: 150 mg (0.79 mmol as reported) of cluster 3 was added to 7 mL MeCN at room temperature. Immediate dissolution and formation of a non-crystalline yellow–brown precipitate occurred. The precipitate was separated by decantation after centrifuging, washed with acetonitrile and dried in vacuo. EPM showed Nd/Tb = 1/5, consistent with residual cluster 1 in starting 3.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: wash with acetonitrile; dry in vacuo; non-crystalline yellow–brown precipitate
